Tutorial_InspectTree.description: NSLOCTEXT("Quests", "Tutorial_InspectTree_Desc", "Understanding trees reveals their hidden potential. Each species offers different resources - some provide straight wood for tools, others yield flexible fibers or medicinal bark.")

objectives.Description: NSLOCTEXT("Quests", "Tutorial_InspectTree_Obj1", "Inspect a tree to learn about its resources")
objectives.HintBody: NSLOCTEXT("Quests", "Tutorial_InspectTree_HintBody", "The circle in the middle of the screen shows what you can do. Interact with a tree (or a stick, a stone...) when the circle turns green: press {key:InteractAction} on a tree and choose Inspect.")

Tutorial_BuildComplete.description: NSLOCTEXT("Quests", "Tutorial_BuildComplete_Desc", "Place a ghost, then add materials to start construction.")

objectives.Description: NSLOCTEXT("Quests", "Tutorial_BuildComplete_Obj2", "Leave build mode and interact with the ghost")
objectives.HintBody: NSLOCTEXT("Quests", "Tutorial_BuildComplete_HintBody", "Leave build mode with {key:CancelPlacementAction:Building}, then walk up to the ghost to add its materials.")

objectives.Description: NSLOCTEXT("Quests", "Tutorial_BuildComplete_Obj3", "Right-click the ghost to add materials")
objectives.HintBody: NSLOCTEXT("Quests", "Tutorial_BuildComplete_HintBody3", "Add materials by right-clicking ({key:SecondaryAction}) on a buildable while the circle is blue, then start building, or cancel.")

Tutorial_Threat.description: NSLOCTEXT("Quests", "Tutorial_Threat_Desc", "A red circle means a threat.")

objectives.HintBody: NSLOCTEXT("Quests", "Tutorial_Threat_HintBody", "Watch out! If the circle is red, it means it's a threat. It turns red on a predator in sight, and on any animal close enough to hit ({key:PrimaryAction} attacks).")
